description:
Create, list, show and delete person files at people/<Name>.md. People are link targets for note attendees and task assignees, never threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people (open only by default); QUERY ranks by fuzzy similarity
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list:
    --all   include closed people
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    PERSON  full name (filename without .md)
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME          required; full name; becomes the filename; no '/' and no leading '.'
    --category CATEGORY  required; professional, personal or voluntary
  delete:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Examples:
  ["list", "sam"]
  ["show", "Sam Rivera", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Sam Rivera", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  delete is permanent and fails without -y. Tasks assigned to a deleted person stop resolving.
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: empty name, name with '/' or a leading '.', already exists, not found, delete without -y.
